stem.text: Which problem can result if too much $\text{NH}_4\text{NO}_3$ is applied to crops by farmers?

A.text: Not all the $\text{NH}_4\text{NO}_3$ is used by plants and the excess makes the soil alkaline.

B.text: Rain washes some of the $\text{NH}_4\text{NO}_3$ into rivers where it forms a precipitate.

C.text: Some of the $\text{NH}_4\text{NO}_3$ dissolves in groundwater which may eventually be used for drinking.

D.text: Ammonia is produced; this lowers the pH of the soil.
